words.meaning: A feeling of pensive sadness, typically with no obvious cause.
words.sentence1: An inexplicable melancholy descended upon him as autumn stripped the trees of their amber leaves. (An inexplicable melancholy descended upon him as autumn stripped the trees of their amber leaves.)
words.sentence2: Her journal was filled with introspective musings and gentle melancholy. (Her journal was filled with introspective musings and gentle melancholy.)

words.meaning: A state of acute anxiety, unease, or inner turmoil.
words.sentence1: La repentina noticia lleno su pecho de una profunda zozobra. (The sudden news filled his chest with deep anxiety.)
words.sentence2: Esperaron el veredicto medico en medio de una constante zozobra. (They waited for the medical verdict in the midst of constant unease.)

words.meaning: A state of helpless confusion, disorientation, or emotional disarray.
words.sentence1: Elle ne put cacher son desarroi face a ce revirement inattendu. (She could not hide her distress in the face of this unexpected turn of events.)
words.sentence2: Un sentiment de desarroi envahit la piece apres l annonce du depart. (A feeling of disarray overwhelmed the room after the departure was announced.)

words.meaning: An ache or deep longing for distant and unexplored places.
words.sentence1: Beim Betrachten der alten Weltkarte packte ihn plotzlich das Fernweh. (Looking at the old world map, he was suddenly seized by wanderlust and longing for distant lands.)
words.sentence2: Ihr standiges Fernweh trieb sie dazu, jeden Sommer in unbekannte Lander zu reisen. (Her constant longing for distant places drove her to travel to unfamiliar countries every summer.)

words.meaning: The feeling of loneliness, solitude, or desolate sorrow.
words.sentence1: Yuuhi ga shizumu toki, mune no oku ni fukai sabishisa o kanjiru. (When the sun sets, I feel a deep loneliness in the depths of my chest.)
words.sentence2: Daremo inai heya ni modotta shunkan, kyuu ni sabishisa ga osotte kita. (The moment I returned to the empty room, loneliness suddenly swept over me.)

words.meaning: A state of being deeply moved or touched with emotional tenderness.
words.sentence1: Gli occhi del vecchio marinaio brillavano di commozione al ritorno del nipote. (The old sailor's eyes shone with deep emotion upon his grandson's return.)
words.sentence2: La melodia straziante suscito una viva commozione in tutto il pubblico. (The poignant melody stirred profound emotion throughout the entire audience.)

words.sentence1: Tingdao zhege buxing de xiaoxi, tade xinli chongmanle beishang. (Upon hearing this tragic news, his heart was filled with grief.)
words.sentence2: Suizhe shijian de liushi, nei fen nonglie de beishang zhongyu jianjian pingxi. (With the passage of time, that intense sorrow finally began to subside.)

words.sentence1: Geu noraereul deureul ttaemada gamsamhan seulpeumi millyeoondeut haessda. (Every time I listened to that song, a delicate sadness seemed to wash over me.)
words.sentence2: Ibyeorui seulpeumeul igyeonaegi wihae geuneun bappage ire yeoljungbaessda. (To overcome the sorrow of parting, he busied himself by immersing in work.)

words.sentence1: Komheung robaoh koat ban thveu aoy koat batbomborng stey. (His anger made him lose his self-control and composure.)
words.sentence2: Neang ban kham somuot komheung knong chet daembei kom aoy mean reung thomm. (She tried hard to suppress the anger in her heart so as not to cause a bigger issue.)

words.sentence1: Die skielike geraas in die donker het hom met koue angs vervul. (The sudden noise in the dark filled him with cold dread.)
words.sentence2: Sy het probeer om die knaende angs voor die belangrike eksamen te onderdruk. (She tried to suppress the gnawing anxiety before the important exam.)
